entries.heading: (a) Section 2326(b)(3) of
ancestors: DIVISION B—EMERGENCY APPROPRIATIONS FOR CORONAVIRUS HEALTH RESPONSE AND AGENCY OPERATIONS
entries.text:
Sec. 13004. (a) Section 2326(b)(3) of 
title 10, United States Code, shall not apply to any undefinitized 
contract action of the Department of Defense related to the national 
emergency for the Coronavirus Disease 2019 (COVID-19).

    (b) In this section, the term ``undefinitized 
contract action'' has the meaning given that term in section 2326(j)(6) 
of title 10, United States Code.
